description: This file implements a storage mechanism for managing an installation registry, including loading, saving, and retrieving package information, using a file system abstraction.

classes.name: LocalRegistryStorage
classes.description: Struct that manages local storage of installation registry using a file system adapter.

methods.name: LoadRegistry
methods.description: Loads the installation registry from a file, returning a new empty registry if the file does not exist.

methods.name: SaveRegistry
methods.description: Serializes and saves the installation registry to a file.

methods.name: GetPackage
methods.description: Retrieves an installed package by name from the registry.

methods.name: SavePackage
methods.description: Adds or updates a package in the registry and saves it.
